name: SortableComposerAttachment
description: Sized placeholder stays in the flex flow (opacity 0). DragOverlay is the pointer ghost — the root reads these `children` for it. Live draft reorder moves this slot to the drop index; wrap skips strategy transforms so siblings FLIP via layout instead of wrong gaps.
